run_profile_timing: run the pybullet profile timing script to log simulation timings to a chrome tracing JSON file
start_state_logging: start pybullet state logging with STATE_LOGGING_PROFILE_TIMINGS to capture simulation performance data
submit_profile_timing: submit a named profile timing marker during simulation to track custom code sections
step_simulation: step the pybullet physics simulation forward one timestep while profiling is active
stop_state_logging: stop pybullet state logging and finalize the chrome tracing JSON output file
